### Metaphors of Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/metaphors-of-love
Passage: Psalm 18:1-3
Points:
- When someone falls deeply in love, they naturally express affection through rich metaphors.
- Obedience to God is commanded, but it should ultimately spring from a heart overflowing with genuine love.
- David poured out descriptive imagery because he had experienced God as his fortress, shield, and deliverer.
- Contemplating who God is and how He provides stirs renewed devotion in the hearts of believers.

### Can't Never Could Do Anything
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-august-18.html
Passage: Psalm 18:29
Points:
- Christians often face daunting challenges with a defeated attitude of what cannot be done.
- Genuine faith is not positive self-talk, but confidence in God's ability to keep His promises.
- With the Lord's enabling power, believers can run through troops and scale imposing walls.
- Overcoming impossible situations requires taking eyes off the storm and resting fully on God's strength.

### God Is Your Strong Foundation
Author: Angie Grant
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/god-is-your-strong-foundation.html
Passage: Psalm 18:2
Points:
- A life may look polished on the outside while concealing significant damage beneath the surface.
- Trusting Christ as a rock and fortress provides stability and peace detached from changing circumstances.
- Daily spiritual habits such as prayer and Scripture reading reinforce our foundation before storms arrive.
- Trials do not destroy a life rooted in God; instead, they prove the strength of the foundation.

### God Is Our Rock
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/god-is-our-rock.html
Passage: Psalm 18:1-2
Points:
- The metaphor of God as a rock emphasizes His steadfastness amidst life's shifting uncertainties.
- David’s depiction of God highlights multifaceted protection, refuge, and saving power.
- Developing consistent prayer and meditation habits attunes believers to God's active presence and voice.
- Leaning on the Lord's unlimited strength replaces anxiety with enduring peace in times of weakness.
